gap-fresh-control-inventory-total.excerpt: Dictionaries preserve insertion order. Note that updating a key does not affect the order. Keys added after deletion are inserted at the end.

gap-fresh-control-jsonl-records.excerpt: Serialize obj to a JSON formatted str using this conversion table. The arguments have the same meaning as in dump().

gap-fresh-control-query-values.excerpt: When a sequence of two-element tuples is used as the query argument, the first element of each tuple is a key and the second is a value. The value element in itself can be a sequence and in that case, if the optional parameter doseq evaluates to True, individual key=value pairs separated by '&' are generated for each element of the value sequence for the key. The order of parameters in the encoded string will match the order of parameter tuples in the sequence.

gap-fresh-control-window-batches.excerpt: The slice of s from i to j is defined as the sequence of items with index k such that i <= k < j. If i or j is greater than len(s), use len(s). If i is omitted or None, use 0. If j is omitted or None, use len(s). If i is greater than or equal to j, the slice is empty.
